summary: Ban raw `process.env` and `Bun.env` outside dedicated `env.ts` / `*.config.*` boundary files.

eslint/no-restricted-properties.message: Raw `Bun.env` is banned outside `env.ts`. Fix: parse environment variables via a Zod schema in `env.ts` and import `env`. Docs: `lints explain ts/no-process-env`.
